portfolio.monetaryScope: All 98 independently scoped IP assets. CAUSORYN at TA-IP-097 is priced for its implemented v0.6.0 local prototype. Software Asset Engineering Platform at TA-IP-098 retains its v0.1.0 local-engine estimate; required future SaaS delivery is excluded. Historical Digital Twin Core values are not inherited.

confidence.replacementCost: Primary seller-side build-versus-buy reference estimating the engineering-equivalent cost to recreate comparable present transferable work product. It is a seller estimate, not a certified cost audit or guaranteed buyer saving.
confidence.sellerAsk: Asset-specific seller acquisition reference anchored primarily to recreation cost and discounted for maturity, transfer readiness, specialist concentration, remaining buyer productization and evidence boundaries.
confidence.marketComparableProxy: Secondary sector-informed analytical proxy. Direct subject-asset comparability is not established.
confidence.incomeLicensingProxy: Secondary monetization proxy. Buyer-specific cash flow and royalty evidence is not established.
confidence.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: Secondary buyer-side context adjusted for maturity, commercialization, rights and time risk.
confidence.triangulatedEconomicReference: Secondary weighted analytical reference rather than the primary asking-price basis.

rebuildCostCalibration.approach: Use the retained engineering-equivalent rates for separate present-scope CAUSORYN and Software Asset Engineering Platform software budgets. The other 96 asset budgets and all economic model factors are retained. The Digital Twin Core predecessor estimate is historical only.
rebuildCostCalibration.rounding: Initial asset-level recreation estimates are rounded conservatively. Asking references use asset-specific discounts; published negotiation bounds are indicative and may use finer rounding for small documentation assets. File and commit counts do not determine price.
rebuildCostCalibration.successorPolicy: Every catalogue project is treated as its own IP asset with its own first-party rights and transfer perimeter. Monetary estimates are established separately for each asset. Project websites are digital displays only.
rebuildCostCalibration.boundary: Only present first-party software, research-software, validation, governance, packaging, documentation and handover work is costed. A definition-stage documentation estimate does not imply implemented software. Future hosting, market execution, speculative outcomes, unexecuted qualification and uncommitted implementation are excluded.

verification.publicArithmetic: The public renderer independently recalculates each asset’s analytical reference from stage, potential, recreation cost, sector and route, compares every result with its register row, then reconciles all portfolio totals.
verification.fileIntegrity: SHA-256 fingerprints for the current valuation register and methodology are published in the public attestation file and verified in the browser.
verification.boundary: Reproducible arithmetic verifies internal consistency of the published model. It does not convert seller assumptions into an independent appraisal, legal title opinion, patent priority opinion, audit or third-party certification.

definitions.replacementCost: Primary seller-side build-versus-buy reference: estimated cost to recreate comparable present transferable work product.
definitions.marketComparableProxy: Secondary modelled marketability indication using maturity, potential and sector context; not a verified precedent-transaction valuation.
definitions.incomeLicensingProxy: Secondary modelled monetization indication; not a DCF or relief-from-royalty valuation.
definitions.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: Secondary buyer-side opportunity reference anchored to replacement cost and adjusted for technical completion, commercialization probability, rights-transfer reserve, time/risk and sector context.
definitions.triangulatedEconomicReference: Secondary weighted analytical reference combining four economic lenses; not certified market value.
definitions.sellerAsk: Indicative seller-side source-code/IP acquisition asking reference positioned primarily against recreation cost.

latestTargetedSoftwarePricing.boundary: Targeted review of TA-IP-097 and the new TA-IP-098 only. Exact source snapshots were checked against Git blob identities. CAUSORYN passed 54 local unit tests, syntax checks and four examples. Software Asset Engineering Platform passed 72 local tests with no failures, errors or skips; engine/test digests match retained local and installed-wheel evidence. Engine verification does not validate ingested project code or legal/commercial conclusions. The other 96 asset records, prices, evidence dates and criteria are retained. No independent legal, security, scientific or market certification is implied.

independentAssetPolicy.rule: Every listed asset has its own identity, rights perimeter and present-scope monetary estimate. No project is represented by another asset. Project websites are digital displays only. Definition documentation is distinguished from implemented software.

definitionStagePolicy.scope: Existing first-party definition/documentation only; no implemented software.
definitionStagePolicy.marketIncomeAndStrategicTreatment: Zero model contributions mean no evidenced software monetisation or technology premium; they do not set the acquisition price or total asset value to zero.
definitionStagePolicy.triangulation: The existing 25% recreation-cost weight applies; market, income and strategic software lenses contribute zero.
definitionStagePolicy.potentialClassification: S is a conservative specialist classification for model arithmetic, not evidence of market demand.
definitionStagePolicy.futureDevelopment: Excluded from present reproduction cost and asking price. No numeric D-stage future sensitivity is established.
